newsitem.title: USA: Garden Botanika April same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Garden Botanika April same store sales rise.

text.p: Garden Botanika Inc on Wednesday said its same-store sales rose 11 percent in the four weeks ended May 3 while total sales rose 54 percent to $7.8 million.
The company, a retailer of personal care products, had 259 stores in operation at the end of the latest reporting period, compared with 162 the year before.
For the 13-week year-to-date period, the company said total sales rose 44 percent to $23.9 million and same-store sales were up two percent.
